copy:
Visit Disney California Adventure Park for an array of fabulous festival events—then stay for the irresistible small plates and beverages available for purchase at different outdoor marketplace kiosks.

Each location’s mouthwatering menu is inspired by fresh, California-grown ingredients like garlic, citrus and peppers. You’ll also discover a variety of artisanal cheeses, locally brewed craft beers and wines from all across the Golden State.

Highlights from the 2026 Event
These offerings may not necessarily return for future festivals.

There’s something for everyone at the festival, including:

  • Brews, flights, wines and specialty beverages at select marketplaces
  • Paradise Beer Garden in Paradise Gardens offering a variety of local craft and brewed beers
Sip and Savor Pass

Taste your way through this celebration of California’s incredible bounty with a Sip and Savor Pass. You can even split a pass with a friend and have a blast sampling food together!
sections.title: A Thrilling (and Filling) Gourmet Scene

copy:
• Peppers Cali-Ente – Snack on hot ‘n’ spicy fare with a Cali twist!
  • Golden Dreams – Tempt taste buds with well-seasoned eats and an invigorating cold brew.
  • LA Style – Feast on favorite southland food-truck flavors.
  • Garlic Kissed – Stop by to savor mouthwatering dishes and specialty beverages.
  • California Craft Brews – Cheers to a round from California’s best local breweries.
  • Mercado de Antojos – Indulge your cravings with bold bites and beverages.
  • Uncork California – Sip vino by the glass or try a flight.
  • Cluck-a-Doodle-Moo – Sample succulent eats along with a refreshing beverage.  

Important Information

Valid Disney California Adventure Park ticket or Magic Key pass and park reservation required. Park reservations are limited, subject to availability and not guaranteed.

featuredMenuItems.title: Meal Pricing
featuredMenuItems.tooltipText: Range reflects the average price of adult dinner entrées (breakfast and lunch generally cost less), except Character Dining locations, buffet locations, dinner shows, and special dining events where range reflects the average adult price of entire meal and non-alcoholic beverages. Range excludes alcoholic beverages, taxes and gratuities except at dinner shows where beer and wine, taxes and gratuities are included.

items.title: Alcoholic Beverages
items.content: Guests must be age 21 or older to purchase or consume alcoholic beverages. Limit 2 alcoholic beverages per Guest per transaction. A valid form of government identification will be required to verify your age. Learn More

items.title: Subject to Change
items.content: Menu items, pricing and hours are subject to change without notice. Entertainment, experiences and offerings may be modified, limited in availability or unavailable, and are subject to restrictions, change or cancellation without notice. Park admission and offerings are not guaranteed.

importantMessage.title: An Important Message
importantMessage.content: In-park dining requires a theme park reservation and valid admission for the same park on the same date for each Guest ages 3 and older. Learn more about available dining options at the Disneyland Resort.
